mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the smooth surfaces to the bones was most worthwhile because the result clearly distinguished a joint that permits movement from something that produces force.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the bones felt least engaging: it established rigid supports but was a predictable first step.

surprise.text: The articulated joint permits the forearm to turn but cannot produce the pull itself; that sharpened my understanding of the framework's limits.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The offered combinations had clear purposes, though most decisions had only one combination available.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how muscles on opposite sides produce the pulls needed to move the framework and eventually lift the glass.
